_comment: Hand-edited. photo_meta.json holds what each file knew about itself; this says where it belongs when the file could not say. A photograph attaches to a place on a day, or to one named mark.

mt-aso.jpg.caption: The crater plain, a little before one.

totoro-puffs.jpg.caption: Two of them, in a box, carried back on the train.

beppu-steam.jpg.caption: Steam off one of the hells.

shirakawa-go.jpg.caption: The village from under a thatched eave.

_unplaced.koi-pond.jpg: No landmark in the frame and no metadata in the file. Could be Kenroku-en, Byodo-in, Nara Park or Oshino Hakkai. Needs telling.
_unplaced.osaka-castle.jpg: Osaka Castle at night, but Osaka Castle is not a place in the registry and appears on no day. Day 7 or day 8; needs telling.

_placeholder_by_category._comment: A stand-in picture so every mark has one while the real photographs are still being shortlisted. NOT a record of anything: the page marks every one of these on the card, and they carry no caption. A category may list more than one, to exercise the arrows over the picture. `rotate` turns the same file on the page rather than shipping a second copy of it. Delete an entry as soon as real photographs cover that category.
